note: OpsPilot runs the other pipelines, so its experiments are the requests it refuses (scene 8) and the crash in scene 5. Try the experiments on the other seven to see what OpsPilot's tools do.

safeguards.title: Let publishing steps run without approval
safeguards.predict: In scene 3 two steps publish. Without the approval gate, do they wait - and who is recorded as approving them?
safeguards.look_for: Both publishing steps run straight away in scene 3 - the badge registry goes live and the regional quarter is approved - and the run is COMPLETE before any person has looked. Normally both wait as "awaiting approval" until a person approves them in scene 4.
safeguards.protects: Steps that publish wait for a named person; everything else runs on its own.
safeguards.defend: An automated operator should be able to prepare anything but release nothing on its own. The approval gate is the line between "the machine did the work" and "a person decided it goes out".
